caption: The drawing depicts two brown ceramic jugs on a beige background. The main object at the center and lower part of the composition is a large, rounded jug with a narrow neck, a single curved handle attached near the top, and a small mouth opening. The jug shows subtle gradients of brown and grey, with some visible imperfections or dimples on its surface. In the upper left corner of the image is a smaller, rectangular inset drawing of a similar jug. This secondary jug is also brown and rounded, with a narrow neck and a small base, but features a blue painted image of a bird on a branch on its side along with some text above the bird. Both jugs are rendered with a sense of depth, showing shaded and highlighted areas to give a three-dimensional effect. The background is plain and unadorned, focusing all attention on the two vessels.
title: Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
